profile_before: phone DWARF profile rta3l3-dwarf: DispatchQueue.asyncAfter 1.55% of the main thread per message-loop iteration, 0.94% of it a write syscall in dispatch_after (libdispatch waking its manager thread for the timer heap); presentMusic 0.63%
change: OriginalRuntimeSessionHost gains scheduleIteration(after:_:), whose default is the previous main-queue asyncAfter; OriginalRuntimeSession.schedule calls it. The Android host arms one timerfd (CLOCK_MONOTONIC, non-blocking) registered on the main ALooper: one timerfd_settime on the main thread per iteration, the callback reads the expiration count and runs the body; fallbacks to asyncAfter when the timerfd cannot be made, when a second body is outstanding, or when arming fails. CAndroidNative includes sys/timerfd.h and unistd.h.
